question: Which roadworks and road closures cause the biggest bus delays?
title: Closures and delays

requires.note: Needs at least two weeks of recorded arrivals to compare delays beside closures with delays elsewhere; the archive started on 21 Nov 2026.

answer.template: Over the last 7 days, buses at stops beside a closure ran {trn.closure_delay_gap} later on average than elsewhere.
answer.empty_text: Not enough recorded arrivals beside closures yet.

trust.note: Beside a closure: a stop within 30 m of the closure line while it is in effect (interim). An association, not proof of cause.
